image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky substrate. The image highlights the dorsal side, showing eight distinct, overlapping calcareous plates (valves) embedded in a hairy, brownish girdle. The plates are dark grey/blue with visible growth lines and texture. The surrounding girdle is covered in fine bristles. The background is out-of-focus rock/water interface.
